description: This file defines a Spring configuration class 'JdbcConfig' that provides bean definitions for database access components such as JdbcTemplate and NamedParameterJdbcTemplate using a custom RoutingDataSource.

classes.name: JdbcConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that declares beans for JDBC templates used for database operations, utilizing a custom routing data source.

methods.name: jdbcTemplate
methods.description: Provides a JdbcTemplate bean configured with the given RoutingDataSource for executing SQL queries.

methods.name: namedParameterJdbcTemplate
methods.description: Provides a NamedParameterJdbcTemplate bean configured with the given RoutingDataSource for executing parameterized SQL queries.
